depth_justification: Engages MindCare's real specifics (AI journal summaries visible to the therapist, crisis-misread risk, therapeutic alliance) with mostly apt GDPR/AI-Act references, but is undermined by heavy looping (the RQ6-8 block is reprinted verbatim and it keeps asking about third-party sharing after the user denied it four times) and a few loose citations.

'Enable data export in a standard format (e.g., CSV or PDF) for users to transfer their data'
